name: Cascade Biotech Life-Sign Earring
description:
A small, stud-style earring with an embedded vital-sign monitor that tracks heart rate, blood pressure, and cortisol levels. The earring communicates via short-range encrypted signal to a paired device. A tiny LED on the earring's surface pulses with the wearer's heartbeat — invisible in daylight, faintly visible in darkness.

Originally designed for patients in post-operative monitoring, the Life-Sign Earring has been adopted by couples, close-knit teams, and protective parents who want real-time confirmation that someone they care about is still alive.
functionality: Real-time vital monitoring, heartbeat LED, encrypted data transmission
what_it_says: Someone is watching your heartbeat right now, and you chose to let them.
story_hooks: A Life-Sign Earring begins transmitting flatline data from someone who was confirmed alive thirty seconds ago — either the earring malfunctioned or something stopped a heart in half a minute.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Pulse Carbine PC-6 'Heartbeat'

physical_description.visual_profile: A minimalist stud earring that sits flush against the earlobe, barely noticeable during daylight. The design reads as medical-grade luxury—clinical precision softened by gentle curves. In low light, a faint bioluminescent pulse becomes visible, creating an intimate, almost vulnerable aesthetic.
physical_description.fit: Pierced earring; sits snug against the earlobe without protruding. Weight is negligible due to biocomposite casing. Designed for all-day wear without discomfort.
physical_description.primary_material: Medical-grade biocomposite polymer housing with embedded sapphire lens over the LED; surgical-steel post and backing for biocompatibility
physical_description.texture: Smooth, polished surface with a slightly domed crown. The sapphire lens has a subtle lens-like quality that catches light faintly. Backing is matte to prevent skin irritation.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte gunmetal gray housing with a clear sapphire lens crown. The embedded LED pulses in soft bioluminescent cyan or rose-gold depending on model variant. The post is surgical steel silver.
physical_description.closures: Standard friction-fit piercing post and backing; no additional fastening required once inserted
distinctive_features: Embedded vital-sign monitoring sensor array (heart rate, blood pressure, cortisol)
Micro-LED that pulses synchronously with wearer's heartbeat
Cascade Biotech logo subtly etched on the backing
Sapphire-topped lens that glows faintly in darkness
Biocompatible surgical-steel components for sensitive skin
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 luxury—expensive medical technology positioned as a lifestyle accessory for the wealthy and health-conscious
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals access to premium biometric tech, medical sophistication, and intimate social bonds. Common among corpo families, medical professionals, and couples in committed relationships. Subtly performative—the wearer displays their vitals to select intimates, suggesting both vulnerability and trust.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine; designed for durability and daily wear. The sapphire lens remains clear even with years of use. Minimal visible wear unless damaged.
